spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace ownership is required. Reply and refund are separate administrator-managed workspace grants; missing or empty grants deny writes.
Queued and running commands do not establish provider completion. Read spellbook_tcg_buyer_action_status and preserve its exact command ID.
After an ambiguous write, inspect the same order or thread to reconcile. Never submit another write or change sessions to bypass an unresolved outcome.

description: Send the seller-authorized exact text to one TCGplayer buyer thread. Requires a verified thread inspection and reply permission. Read spellbook_tcg_buyer_action_status afterward; delivery requires a verified seller message with its provider message ID.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

message.description: Exact reply text authorized by the seller. Required.

previewIntentId.description: Successful recent order or thread inspection command ID. Required.

refundIntentId.description: Verified same-order refund command ID when the reply claims a completed refund. Omit for other replies.

sessionId.description: Exact sessionId returned by spellbook_tcg_buyer_driver_status. Required.

threadId.description: Exact threadId in the verified inspection. Required.

workspaceId.description: Workspace owned by the authenticated seller. Required.

name: spellbook_tcg_buyer_reply
